description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment called LogFragment, which contains a custom LogView for displaying log data. It manages the creation, layout, and text change listening for the log view within the fragment's UI.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a log view for outputting log data, managing the layout and scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components, setting layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets up a text change listener to scroll to the bottom when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
